meta.title: Bulk counter offer on a Global Field

plan.title: Bulk Counter Offer on Global Field

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.

args.title: Bulk Counter Offer Global Field Test

steps.note: Configure the event as an RFQ so bulk counter offers are available on its pricing stage.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding items.

args.goal: configure a global field on the RFQ create screen and leave the event showing that global field ready for use in the pricing sheet

steps.note: Configure the global field required by the case; no dedicated catalog step exists for creating one.
Add a line item for the RFQ.
Invite multiple vendors so the bulk action can target all of them.
Publish the RFQ before collecting bids.
Verify the RFQ reached a published project page.
Submit a bid from the first invited vendor.
Verify the first vendor's bid was accepted.
Submit a bid from a different invited vendor so the bulk action has multiple recipients.
Verify the second vendor's bid was accepted.
Open the bulk counter-offer drawer from the RFQ Settings menu.

args.goal: select the configured global field, enter a new counter value, click Send Counter Offer, and stop when the screen shows the global field's original and counter values highlighted for the bulk request

steps.note: Perform and observe the global-field bulk counter offer flow, including the value comparison that has no dedicated assertion step.
Verify Procol reports the bulk counter offer as successfully sent.
Verify every invited vendor has the Counter Offer Requested tag.
